source.pair_rule: match exact degree multisets; adjacent index pairs
source.source: Read-Wilson, An Atlas of Graphs (1998), via NetworkX

mathematical_hypotheses.external_literature_screening_note: Lovasz 1967 graph-hom count characterization; multiplicativity of disjoint source hom counts is elementary and established

independent_finite_and_combinatorial_cer.combinatorial_argument: every adjacency-preserving map from a disconnected source uniquely restricts to one independent map per component; independent component maps uniquely glue to one full map

overgeneralized_degree_to_tree_conjectur.basis: degree-matched graph carriers and simpler tree probes
overgeneralized_degree_to_tree_conjectur.speculative_broad_conjecture: identical degree multisets imply identical all-tree hom counts
overgeneralized_degree_to_tree_conjectur.test_source: independently originated Read/Wilson Atlas training graphs
